name: Recovery Code Sign-In Could Not Authenticate
summary: An identified returning user submits a TOTP recovery code that is not accepted; no authenticated session is created and the recovery-code entry surface remains visible with a non-enumerating error.

preconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and an active durable identity with confirmed email, enabled TOTP, recovery codes, and an outstanding MFA requirement is prepared for sign-in

inputs.name: Recovery Code
inputs.description: A deliberately invalid or previously consumed recovery code used to prove the rejected outcome.

serverInteraction.intent: Resolve the existing durable identity held by the MFA challenge, reject the submitted recovery-code proof without establishing a session, and preserve the outstanding MFA requirement.

postconditions.expression: the durable identity remains active with TOTP enabled, no authenticated session is established, and the recovery-code entry surface remains visible without disclosing rejection internals

sourceReferences.note: ConsumeRecoveryCodeAsync rejects missing, unavailable, invalid, or previously consumed recovery codes without authenticating the user.
Rejected recovery-code proof remains on the recovery-code view and does not reveal why the code was not accepted.
